hypotheses.O0_saved_factor_recomposition_is_exact: Saved CE output covectors, write adjoints, and behavioral effects equal prediction-minus-target to relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.O1_shared_static_suffix_predicts_write_a: The validation-selected shared output-to-write map retains at least 0.80 of prediction, target, and margin write-adjoint energy on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.O2_shared_static_suffix_predicts_behavio: The same shared map retains at least 0.80 of prediction, target, and margin behavioral effects on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.O3_shared_static_suffix_explains_model_m: The shared map retains at least 0.90 of model-margin behavioral effects on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.O4_shared_map_matches_component_specific: Shared-map behavioral fidelity is within 0.05 of separately validation-selected component-specific ridge maps for every component and corpus.
hypotheses.O5_weighted_map_beats_scaled_identity: The shared map exceeds a fitted shared scaled-identity baseline by at least 0.20 behavioral fidelity for every component and corpus.
hypotheses.O6_static_suffix_description_is_rank128_: Validation selects a shared output-covector rank of at most 128.
hypotheses.O7_shared_suffix_map_transfers_ood: For each component, WikiText and TinyStories behavioral fidelity are within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.O8_output_covector_rank_accounts_for_wri: For prediction, target, and margin, discovery output-covector and write-adjoint R90 differ by at most 32.
